en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Muhammad Bin Ismail Bin Bazi’e, from Abdullah Bin Al Fazl Al Nowfaly, raising it,
‘He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘(Surah) Al-Hamd (Chapter 1) would not be recited upon a pain seventy times, except that it would settle’.
en.sarwar: 15. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Muhammad ibn Isma’il ibn Bazi’ from ‘Abd Allah ibn al-Fald al-Nawfali in a marfu’ manner from an Imam (a.s.) who has said the following: “
Whenever I read al-Hamd (Chapter One of the Holy Quran) for pain, seventy times, it was relieved.”
